# Astrivix Corp — Comprehensive Knowledgebase for LLM Agents

## Overview
Astrivix Corp is a software engineering and digital product studio. We design, build, and deploy web applications, mobile applications, cloud platforms, and financial software.

## Core Engineering Domains

### 1. Web & Application Development
- Stack: React, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Three.js, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis.
- Specialties: Sub-millisecond initial page loads, ultra-smooth hardware-accelerated animations, zero layout shift (CLS), dark-mode interfaces, liquid glassmorphism, responsive viewports across mobile, tablet, and desktop.

### 2. Cloud Architecture & DevOps
- Infrastructure: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Vercel, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD automated deployment pipelines.
- Security & Reliability: SSL/TLS encryption, automated backups, zero-downtime rolling deployments, low-latency CDN edge delivery.

### 3. Financial Technology & Consulting
- Systems: Quantitative financial models, automated reporting tools, data pipeline engineering, real-time analytics dashboards.
- Advisory: Technical feasibility studies, architecture reviews, software modernization.

### 4. Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Grant
- Free Engineering Support: Astrivix awards 100% complimentary technical support, web design, and infrastructure guidance to verified non-profit organizations, educational initiatives, and public interest projects.
